definition: Tetyana Nikolaevna Baydyk (born 1954, Ukrainian: Байдик Тетяна Миколаївна, also published as Tatiana Baidyk) is a Ukrainian researcher in artificial neural network based image recognition, particularly for problems of handwriting recognition and the manufacture of microelectromechanical systems.
details: She is also interested in the application of micromechanics in renewable energy, including for concentrated solar power. She works at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), in the Microtechnology and Neural Networks group of the Department of Micro and Nanotechnologies of the Institute for Applied Sciences and Technology (ICAT).

explainer.lead: Tetyana Baydyk is an Ukrainian researcher.

timeline.what: She worked as a junior researcher and then researcher at the Institute of Cybernetics, beginning in 1980.
She became a researcher at UNAM in 2001.

affiliations: National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine
